local_articles.snippet: Cincinnati - Iga Swiatek moved into the semi-finals of the ATP-WTA Cincinnati Masters as Elena Rybakina was forced to retire with a heel injury less than half an hour into their clash on Aug 20. Rybakina’s withdrawal just 10 days before the start of the US Open raised concerns over the fitness of the world No. 2 Kazakh, who lost in the final of last week’s Toronto event to Swiatek. Trailing 4-1 in the opening set of the Cincinnati quarter-final, Rybakina suddenly pulled up short at 40-all, heading to her bench and consulting with the trainer. She went back out and played one more point before quitting. “I was feeling anxious watching the whole situation,” said her opponent Swiatek. “I hope she will be fine. local_articles.title: Russell takes sprint pole at Dutch Grand Prix ahead of Norris
local_articles.snippet: ZANDVOORT, Netherlands, Aug 21 - George Russell put Mercedes on pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race ahead of McLaren's Formula One champion Lando Norris. Russell produced a best lap of one minute 11.567 seconds to beat his fellow Briton by 0.041 of a second. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc will line up third for Saturday's race with McLaren's Oscar Piastri fourth and championship leader Kimi Antonelli qualifying fifth for Mercedes. Home hero Max Verstappen was sixth fastest for Red Bull and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton seventh. The sprint winner takes eight points with the top eight scoring. REUTERS

local_articles.title: Antonelli fastest in sole Dutch GP practice
local_articles.snippet: ZANDVOORT, Netherlands, Aug 21 - Formula One championship leader Kimi Antonelli started the second half of the season with the fastest time for Mercedes in sole practice for the Dutch Grand Prix on Friday. The Italian, who turns 20 next week, lapped the seaside Zandvoort circuit in a best time of one minute 12.949 seconds with McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris second and 0.121 slower on a dry track after a rainy start to the day. Norris, the 2024 winner at Zandvoort, won in Hungary before the August break and McLaren are chasing a third Dutch GP win in a row. The weekend is being run to the sprint format, with qualifying for Saturday's points-scoring 100km race later on Friday. Qualifying for Sunday's grand prix is on Saturday afternoon.
